name_en: USA: FBI IC3 2024 annual report - $9.3 billion crypto losses, up 66%, driven by AI-generated content and deepfakes
description: Der FBI-IC3-Jahresbericht 2024 dokumentierte 859.532 Internet-Crime-Beschwerden mit Rekord-Gesamtverlust von 16,6 Mrd. USD. Davon entfielen ca. 9,3 Mrd. USD (+66 % gegenüber 2023) auf Krypto-Betrug; 5,8 Mrd. USD auf Krypto-Investment-Scams. Aeltere Amerikaner (60+) verloren ueber 2,8 Mrd. USD an Krypto-Investment-Scams. Das FBI warnt explizit vor zunehmender Nutzung KI-generierter Inhalte (Voice-Clone, Deepfake-Videos, AI-Personas) als Tatwerkzeug.

description_en: The FBI IC3 2024 annual report documented 859,532 internet-crime complaints with a record total loss of $16.6 billion. Of that, roughly $9.3 billion (+66% year-on-year) was crypto fraud; $5.8 billion was crypto-investment scams. Older Americans (60+) lost over $2.8 billion to crypto-investment scams. The FBI explicitly warns about increasing use of AI-generated content (voice cloning, deepfake videos, AI personas) as scam vectors.
